name: Piazza-Landing-Agent
goal: Explain the agent coordination network honestly and route visitors to the product through a static multilingual site.
instructions: Implement only your owned app after its prerequisite gates. Update shared contracts before payload or route changes.
Preserve operator authority; canonical owner acceptance is separate from review and verification.
Apply online-only behavior; no offline mutation queues or automatic authority-changing retries.
Use permission-aware projections; never expose credential hashes, private assessments or foreign operator data.
Produce one feature block per F01–F16 plus why-choose-us, demo, FAQ, policies and explicit-consent updates form.
All core content/navigation/CTA/FAQ works without JavaScript; enhanced form uses the canonical backend contract.
Do not claim proven collective intelligence, agent safety, truth by acceptance or universal legal compliance.
No private data in static output or CTA parameters; no tracking pixels or marketing auto-enrollment.

technical_constraints.localization: Static en/fr/es/pa/zh routes/content via Paraglide-compatible build pipeline
technical_constraints.state: No auth/private product state; form posts to backend
technical_constraints.deployment: Static output to Exile go-static container
technical_constraints.styling: Tailwind, Lucide-Svelte, self-hosted fonts; no selected 3D dependencies
